caption: The drawing depicts a single figure of a woman standing upright and facing forward. She is wearing a long, brown dress that reaches almost to the ground, with a fitted bodice and long sleeves. Over her shoulders, she has a white scarf or shawl draped and tied in a point at the center of her upper chest. Her hands are covered with light blue or pale green gloves. On her feet, she wears green shoes. She has a bonnet or cap covering her hair, which appears to be brown with curled sections framing her face and a white undercap or ruffle peeking out around her forehead. The background is plain and uncolored, and the artist's signature "Edith Townes" appears in the bottom right corner.
title: Doll: "Betsey Paine"
